message.content:
Below is a concise list of the **long‑weekend periods** created by Canada’s federal statutory holidays in 2023.  
(For holidays that fall on a weekend, the “observed” date is the weekday on which the holiday is actually taken.)

| Federal Holiday | Observed / Actual Date | Long‑Weekend Span (inclusive) |
|-----------------|------------------------|--------------------------------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 2 2023 (observed) | **Dec 31 2022 – Jan 2 2023** |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 2023 | **Apr 7 – 9 2023** |
| Victoria Day | May 22 2023 | **May 20 – 22 2023** |
| Canada Day | Jun 30 2023 (observed) | **Jun 30 – Jul 2 2023** |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 2023 | **Sep 2 – 4 2023** |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 9 2023 | **Oct 7 – 9 2023** |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 10 2023 (observed) | **Nov 10 – 12 2023** |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25 2023 | **Dec 23 – 25 2023** |
| Boxing Day | Dec 26 2023 | **Dec 23 – 26 2023** |

> **Note:**  
> • The long‑weekend spans shown above include the holiday itself plus the adjacent weekend days.  
> • Some provinces observe additional holidays (e.g., Family Day, St. Patricks’ Day, etc.). If you need province‑specific long weekends, let me know and I can generate those lists too.
